review.notes: All 19 physical pages diffed line-by-line against the OCR markdown (normalized, punctuation/case-insensitive, LaTeX-equivalent math accepted); flagged lines triaged against rendered pages. The arXiv side stamp on physical p.1 is not reader content. Footnote bodies 1-3, 4, 5, 7, 8 and 9 were dropped by OCR while the markers survive; each body was restored after the paragraph carrying its marker and verified at 300 dpi. The superscript on 'line exact match accuracy' is printed as 5 (verified at 400 dpi) and OCR wrote $^{4}$. The appendix language list had 'Execline' misread as 'Excline', a missing comma after 'Modelica', and the run from 'NCL' through 'Zimpl' glued without comma separators, including the lost hyphen in 'Transact-SQL' (restored from the p.19 print). The author block prints 'Y. Wu / Yukun Li', 'Damai Dai / Kai Dong', 'Bingxuan Wang / Junxiao Song', 'Wenjun Gao / Xuan Lu', 'Chenggang Zhao / Chong Ruan' with line breaks and no commas, so the markdown's spacing mirrors the print and was left unchanged; the dropped '*Core contributors' footnote was restored. The print's own spellings 'Defec4J may need modify' (p.11), 'DeepSeekCoder-V2' (p.13, verified at 400 dpi) and reference title casing were kept. The print itself has no footnote 6 (numbering jumps 5 to 7). Chart labels on p.6-7 are inside embedded figure images; the FIM token formula on p.5 is present in the markdown as LaTeX.
